            "cyber_alert", "retro_beep", "zen_bowl", "echo_ping", "digital_chime",
            "sci_fi_sweep", "soft_click", "tech_chirp", "bubble_pop", "crystal_bell",
            "mac_connect", "mac_disconnect", "SystemAsterisk", "SystemExclamation",
            "SystemHand", "SystemQuestion", "SystemDefault"
        ]
        self._add_combo(f_vis_right, "Sound Effect:", "ht_toast_sound_effect", 10, sound_choices)
 
        f3 = tk.Frame(f_vis, bg=TH["bg"])
        f3.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(15, 0))
        
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Enable Shadow/Glow", "ht_toast_shadow", 0)
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Enable Gradient BG", "ht_toast_gradient", 1)
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Enable Accent Stripe", "ht_toast_accent_stripe", 2)
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Show Progress Bar", "ht_toast_progress_bar", 3)
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Auto-Dismiss", "ht_toast_auto_dismiss", 4)
        self._add_grid_chk(f3, "Play Sound", "ht_toast_enable_sound", 5)
 
        btn_frame = tk.Frame(scrollable_frame, bg=TH["bg"])
        btn_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(10, 0))
 
        tk.Button(
            btn_frame, text="[ PREVIEW IN HUB ]", font=("Consolas", 10, "bold"),
            bg=TH["bg2"], fg=TH["accent"], activebackground=TH["bg3"], activeforeground=TH["accent"],
            relief=tk.FLAT, cursor="hand2",
            command=lambda: self.switch_to_preview_hub("Health Tip"), padx=20, pady=8,
        ).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)"
